pendingRegistration.auth: ZEABUR_TOKEN set server-side as environment variable

knownIssues: The hub's internal connection to the open-tgate-mcp resource returns HTTP 500 on tool listing (server-side defect in open-connect.site); the direct Composio registration of open-tgate works correctly.

RESOLVED: the Zeabur MCP server is a local stdio process (npx @zeabur/mcp-server with ZEABUR_TOKEN) with no remote HTTP URL, which made direct Composio registration structurally impossible. Solution: hillstreet-ph/zeabur-mcp-bridge wraps it with an MCP stdio-to-HTTP proxy (mcp-proxy) for hosted deployment. Set ZEABUR_TOKEN as a service environment variable; never commit the token to a public repository.

zeaburBridge.architecture: @zeabur/mcp-server (stdio) wrapped by mcp-proxy to expose HTTP on port 8080
zeaburBridge.deploy: Import the repository as a Zeabur service; set ZEABUR_TOKEN from the Zeabur dashboard (Settings, API tokens); endpoint is the service URL.
zeaburBridge.security: Protect the endpoint via Zeabur private networking or an authenticated open-tgate.site gateway route before registering publicly.

deployments.zeabur: All satellite repos carry zbpack.json {"type":"static"}; import via the Zeabur dashboard.
